summary: Four of last week's ten ranked portfolio actions shipped inside the week, the first time the top of this list has moved rather than aged: Hordes campaign mode became winnable in v0.99.76 with a regression test, the Gnosis licence exposure closed at the build step, the Chains key-value backup task got registered and has produced four consecutive daily snapshots, and the Chains offline cache that had survived twenty-seven reviews landed in v1.8.0. The queue drained from 169 rows to 49 with the blocked-on-user pile falling 89 to 23, and the decision pipeline now holds fourteen dated briefs with none past deadline. Against that sit three measurement failures. Every project's finding-age counter reset, so the highest runsOpen in the portfolio is 2 where last week's report cited 27. The actionsClosed field means a running total in eight projects and a per-run count in two, so closures cannot be summed. And the cost series revised a published week downward by $1,734 while the all-time total rose $15,224 across seven days that spent $2,645.

topActions.label: Fix the finding-age counter before the next constellation. The highest runsOpen in the portfolio is 2 where last week cited 27, and 224 of 249 findings read 1, so every chronic ranking in the last four reports rests on a counter that reset.

BLOCK: five private artifacts are still fetchable from the public hub's git history, re-verified today at commits 20645e84, c79abf5a and c2dcd36b. Rule on a rewrite or a written acceptance, and switch collect-usage.ps1 off its deny-list in the same pass.
Decide which number the spend series is. The same file revised a published week down $1,734.12 while the all-time total rose $15,224.20 across a week that spent $2,644.66.
Restore the approved-permission grants on the sixteen enabled scheduled tasks, or record that they are not needed. Fifteen of sixteen hold none and everything kept running for nine days.
Work hbh-asset-production-pass or close it. Added 2026-06-10, blocked-on-user, 88 days old, against a rule that says seven. Fifteen more blocked rows carry no typed reason.
Publish the dashboard. usage-refresh ran at 11:18 today and the served copy is stamped 2026-09-04T23:18:43Z, so the routine generates and never pushes.

topActions.label: Fix the all-day event date truncation. An event with an explicit offset is normalised to universal time then cut to ten characters, so a late-evening local time books the following day silently.

Stop the bank sync advancing its cursor past rows it dropped. sync.ts:150-157 maps only accounts already carrying an identifier, :176-177 skips the rest with no counter, :85-87 persists the cursor regardless.
Settle what actionsClosed means and make all ten projects write it the same way. Eight accumulate, two reset, so no portfolio closure figure can be checked.
Replace the constellation's drift-fixes liveness check with a dated run record. All ten projects fail the 24-hour check and none of them is broken.
